display.title: Episode 153: On the Road, Chapter 1
display.summary_short: Yaakov's ladder and the secret of davening, honoring parents through good behavior, and a Chassid of the Baal Shem Tov is puzzled by the bare cabin of the Maggid of Mezritch.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week after Parshas Vayeitzei. Uncle Yossi explains Yaakov Avinu's dream of the ladder reaching to Heaven: the Zohar teaches that it is the secret of davening, with our words going up and Hashem's blessings coming down, so we must say every word carefully and with joy. After the Hakochainik march and the sponsor, Mitzvah Time continues the contest on honoring parents: a caller remembers to stand up when a parent enters, and the new lesson is that the greatest honor we give our parents is to learn Torah, keep mitzvos and behave well. A boy and his sisters, visiting with their mother, lead the Shema. Story time begins a new tale: the Baal Shem Tov sends his Chassid Reb Chaim with a sealed letter to his great student, Reb Ber, later the Maggid of Mezritch. Reb Chaim is shocked to find the Maggid living in the shabbiest cabin in town, with logs for chairs and a plank for a table, and resolves to learn why; the lesson waits for next week. The show ends with an invitation to the 'Wonderful World of Shabbos' exhibition.
display.lesson: Davening is a ladder that reaches Hashem; and the best honor we give our parents is to live by the Torah.
